peer_review_model.notes: Double-anonymized peer review is used for Registered Reports, with reviewers evaluating the study proposal before data collection (Stage 1) and the completed manuscript (Stage 2).

latex_accepted.notes: Not explicitly mentioned, but common in scientific publishing.

template_provided.notes: A Stage 1 Registered Report template is provided for authors.

article_types.description: A format for empirical articles in which the hypotheses, methods, and planned analyses undergo peer review before the research is conducted.

total_word_limit.notes: No word limit stated anywhere in the text -- confirmed absence, not something unchecked.

article_types.reference_style: Complete references including article titles and page ranges; no specific style mentioned.
required_statements: A statement confirming that all necessary support (e.g. funding, facilities) and approvals (e.g. ethics) are in place for the proposed research.

A statement indicating whether the Registered Report is intended for research based on pre-existing data and if so, a statement confirming that the authors have neither looked at, downloaded, or analysed the data before receiving an in-principle acceptance of their Stage 1 report.
A statement confirming that the authors agree to share their raw data, any digital study materials, computer code and laboratory log (if relevant) for all published results.
article_types.notes: The Registered Report format is a two-stage process, with peer review before and after data collection. Authors must adhere to the registered experimental procedures and analysis pipeline.

remarks: No article processing charges (APCs) or open-access licensing information mentioned in the provided text.
